newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain intercepts big Internet child porn ring.
newsitem.headline: Spain intercepts big Internet child porn ring.

text.p: Police in Barcelona have cracked Spain's first Internet crime case and uncovered a ring of child pornography distributors using the computer network, Police Chief Federico Cabrero said on Thursday.
Cabrero said two Barcelona men aged 20 and 21 had been arrested after police searched their homes and found a cache of porn videos, photographs, CD ROMs, computer discs and equipment.

The more than 4,000 images seized were of children from three years of age, alone and with other minors and adults, practising "all types of sex acts, including sodomy and masochism". Cabrero said the images appeared to have come from northern and eastern Europe.

The four-month investigation was helped by the U.S. Treasury Department, which had detected the activity of an Internet production and distribution network operating out of the northern Spanish region of Catalonia.

Cabrero said his department had distributed information about the network to other countries in Europe, America and Asia to try to find the authors of the images and to identify the minors and adults appearing in them.
The two men were arrested at the weekend and provisionally released after a court appearance.
